title: The Ninja Forms – Contact Form Builder with Calculators, Quizzes, Signatures & AI Form Builder plugin for WordPress is…
description: The Ninja Forms plugin for WordPress up to version 3.15.5 is vulnerable to reflected DOM-based cross-site scripting (XSS) via a crafted 'querystring:<key>' URL parameter. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary scripts that execute in the context of a victim's browser if they are tricked into clicking a malicious link.
